headline: Mistral opens its 1-trillion-parameter Large 4 model
body: Mistral released the weights of Large 4, a 1-trillion-parameter model aimed at coding and cyber defence, and The Information reported DeepSeek and Moonshot built their latest models using OpenAI's Astra outputs; together they cut Power Concentration by 0.46. GitHub said agents opened over 40% of pull requests in September (AI Autonomy +0.19). Swing-state polls found voters want AI safeguards, House Democrats proposed opposing AI bailouts and Finnish police opened a criminal probe into Google's data-center site (Tech Backlash +0.33). Enslaved God fell; Reversion and Libertarian Utopia rose. Successors stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance rose to -17.53 from -17.65.
movers_note: Enslaved God -0.3, from the DeepSeek-Moonshot distillation report (-0.14), Mistral's open weights (-0.10) and GitHub's agent figures (-0.06). Reversion +0.3, from the swing-state polls (+0.14), the House bailout resolution (+0.14) and the Finnish probe (+0.04). Libertarian Utopia +0.3, from the distillation report (+0.14) and Mistral's release (+0.13).
